source.name: The journey-equivalence experiment's nine multi-step journeys (2026-08-25), promoted to a permanent instrument: three families (support-ticket pipeline extract→classify→reply→report; code pipeline spec-tighten→implement→harden; data pipeline extract→reason→extract), 2–4 steps each, every step's output feeding the next. Task completion is the atomic outcome: only the FINAL artifact is scored, deterministically (field-contains / code-exec) — no judge anywhere. Constraints are carried forward explicitly in step prompts (the constraint-erosion lesson: run 1 of the experiment lost a function-name contract at a restate step in every arm until the spec pinned it).
